description: Retrieve confirmed customer domains currently using a specified vendor from STRAELO's persisted CSI coverage. Returns only confirmed `PRESENT` customer-vendor relationships with supporting evidence and confirmation timestamps, normalized and deduplicated. Results represent STRAELO's currently confirmed coverage and must not be interpreted as the vendor's complete global customer base. **USE WHEN:** an agent needs to identify which customers are currently confirmed as using a specific vendor. **DO NOT USE WHEN:** scanning a specific customer domain for detectable vendors (use customer-vendor-detection), retrieving historical adoption/removal events (use vendor-customer-adoption-change-lookup), or identifying customer transition signals (use vendor-customer-transition-signal-lookup). Parameter semantics: `vendor` identifies the vendor whose confirmed customers should be queried (exact match after normalization); `limit` controls the maximum number of returned customer domains (public range 1–100, default 100). An empty result means STRAELO currently has no confirmed customers available for that vendor within its coverage; it does not mean the vendor has no customers.

vendor.description: Technology/vendor to query confirmed customers for (e.g., klaviyo, yotpo, judge.me).
vendor.title: Vendor

name: vendor_customer_confirmed_lookup

confirmed_customer_count.description: Total confirmed PRESENT customers for the vendor.

customers.description: Confirmed customer relationships, ordered by confirmation freshness.

customer_domain.description: Confirmed customer domain using the technology/vendor.

fingerprint_identifiers.items: Fingerprint identifiers that matched during confirmation.

last_confirmed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the PRESENT relationship was last confirmed.

response_validity.description: Response validity of the confirming observation.

scanner_version.description: Scanner version that produced the confirmation.

returned_count.description: Number of customers returned in this response (bounded by limit).
